description: Term Finance has reported an estimated $8.5 million loss after an attacker exploited the governance controls of its strategy vaults. Security firms said the hacker gained enough voting power to pass proposals that enabled control of the vaults, draining Ether and stablecoins. Term has halted its Meta Vaults while it works with external security experts on asset recovery and remediation.
title: Term Finance Reports Estimated $8.5 Million Loss Following Governance Exploit

description: The Blood of Dawnwalker will get a 60fps Performance mode patch on PS5 and Xbox Series X at launch, developer Rebel Wolves has confirmed. After initially announcing that the game would not have a 60fps mode, the studio confirmed on Monday that Performance mode will be added via a day one patch.
title: The Blood of Dawnwalker Will Get a 60 FPS Performance Mode Patch on Consoles at Launch

description: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G will debut in India on September 4 at 12pm IST, with Flipkart set to handle sales. The smartphone will feature a 6.76-inch full-HD+ display with a 144Hz refresh rate and a rear Active Matrix Cube for notifications and visual effects. It will come in four finishes, while specifications of the global model suggest a Dimensity 7100 chipset, up to 8GB of RAM, 256GB storage and a 5,600mAh or 6,000mAh battery with 45W charging.
title: Infinix Hot 70 Pro 5G India Launch Date Revealed, Key Details Confirmed

description: In recent years, the Pixel has been transitioned from a phone with a really, really good camera to something closer to a showcase for Google’s software and AI ecosystem. The Pixel 11 not only continues this approach but is probably the most cohesive expression of it yet. It is definitely not a phone for you if you want the fastest processor, the brightest display, or the quickest charging. But it is the ideal choice for those who value the Pixel experience. This is, ultimately, Pixel 11’s biggest strength and its biggest limitation. It is very much a Google phone.
title: Google Pixel 11 Review: More Gemini, Same Pixel DNA

description: Realme will launch the C100i in India on August 27, with Flipkart confirming that sales will start on the same day. The Indian model is expected to feature 4GB of RAM and up to 128GB of storage, with Skyline Silver and Midnight Black colour options. A 120Hz display and 6,500mAh battery have been confirmed for the Indian version. The C100i is already sold in select global markets, where it has a different battery capacity and other specifications. Realme has not announced its Indian pricing.
title: Realme C100i India Launch Date Confirmed; Key Features, Flipkart Availability Revealed

description: Samsung is rumoured to be developing Exynos 2700 as its next-generation flagship processor for mobile devices. It is expected to power the Galaxy S27 series, which is slated to debut in at a Galaxy Unpacked event in early 2027. While the South Korean tech conglomerate has yet to confirm its plans, a new report suggests that Samsung’s proprietary processor may have outperformed Qualcomm's next-generation Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 series chips in Samsung's internal testing.
title: Samssung’s Exynos 2700 SoC Reportedly Outperforms Next-Gen Snapdragon Chips in Geekbench, GPU and AI Tests

description: Mivi will launch its first phone in India soon, a marketing poster confirms. The poster has been made live on Flipkart, confirming that the tech firm’s first handset will be available for purchase in India via the e-commerce site. Moreover, the image teases that the Mivi phone will be offered in at least a green colourway. It is also shown to sport a flat rear panel with rounded corners. Currently, Mivi is primarily an audio brand. Mivi’s product portfolio includes true wireless stereo (TWS), Bluetooth speakers, AI-powered earbuds, soundbars, and speakers.
title: Mivi Confirmed to Enter the Indian Smartphone Market; Starts Teasing Design, Availability Details

description: WazirX has launched an AI-powered trading assistant that combines market research, technical analysis, portfolio monitoring, and trade preparation. The tool can provide live market insights with charts, analyse WazirX balances and prepare orders within a conversation. It also supports automated alerts and a paper trading environment for users who want to test strategies before using real funds.
title: WazirX Launches AI Assistant to Help Users Research and Trade Crypto

description: Motorola is said to preparing another round of price hikes for several smartphones under its portfolio in India. It is expected to become the latest brand to do so, following recent price hikes by OnePlus, Realme, Samsung, and Vivo. According to a tipster, Motorola’s recent price hike affects two mid-range smartphones, including the Motorola Edge 70 Fusion and Motorola Edge 60 Fusion, with both soon becoming more expensive to buy compared to their launch prices.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Fusion, Edge 60 Fusion Prices Could Rise by Rs. 3,000 in India

description: Xiaomi 18 Fold and Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max will be launched in China in September, the company announced on Monday. The smartphone is confirmed to debut as the first device to feature Xiaomi’s proprietary Xring 03 chipset. The foldable will be accompanied by the new flagship tablet, Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max, which will be launched with the same Xring 03 chipset as the Xiaomi 18 Fold. However, the exact launch date remains under wraps. The company has started teasing key details about the Xiaomi Xring 03 chipset. The tech firm has revealed that its future devices will get a tri-chip solution, with the Xring 03 SoC accompanied by the Xring O100 AI acceleration chip and the Xring D100 AI chip.
title: Xiaomi 18 Fold and Pad 9 Pro Max Confirmed to Launch Next Month With the Firm’s New Xring O3 Chipset

description: Sony has started sending out email communication to PlayStation users, detailing the full PlayStation terms of usage. In the email the company states that users do not own digitally purchased games and are only granted a licence to use digital products.
title: Sony Tells PlayStation Users They Don't Own Their Digital Games Amidst Backlash Over Ending Physical Discs

description: Vivo has taken the wraps off its V80 Lite 5G smartphone and announced the same in Pakistan. The launch has revealed all the specifications of the device for that market, revealing how similar it is to the Vivo S2 which was recently launched in the Indian market.
title: Vivo V80 Lite 5G Launched With MediaTek Dimensity 7360 SoC, 7050mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: Sony has expanded its professional audio lineup in India with the IER-M500 wired in-ear monitors. The earphones use a 5mm dynamic driver and offer a 10Hz to 40,000Hz frequency response, 16-ohm impedance and 103dB/mW sensitivity. They feature a sealed housing for passive noise isolation and come with noise-isolating ear tips, fitting supporters and a cable clip. The IER-M500 weighs 6.9g without its cable and uses a 1.6m Y-type cable with an L-shaped stereo mini plug.
title: Sony IER-M500 Wired In-Ear Monitors Launched in India With 5mm Driver, Hi-Res Audio: Price, Features

description: After several leaks and rumours Sony’s much-awaited Xperia 10 VIII leaks ahead of launch day. The leak which contains what appears to be an official image of the soon to be released smartphone, gives us an early look at the devices from various angles.
title: Sony Xperia 10 VIII Design Leaked Ahead of Expected August 25 Launch

description: Vivo X500 series will be launched in China in September, Vivo Product Manager Han Boxiao announced on Monday in a Weibo post. The company executive has also announced that the upcoming lineup will include the Vivo X500, Vivo X500 Pro, and Vivo X500 Pro Max. This also confirms that the tech firm is changing its product strategy this year with the addition of the new Pro Max model, unlike last year, when the company unveiled only two models initially, namely Vivo X300 and Vivo X300 Pro.
title: Vivo X500 Series Launch Set for Next Month as Executive Reveals ‘Major’ Camera Upgrades

description: Apple is reportedly changing parts of its retail stores ahead of new Home hardware expected this autumn. The work will reportedly include modifications to display areas and additional accessory bays. While an updated Apple TV and HomePod mini are already expected, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman believes the scale of the changes could indicate preparations for Apple's first smart home hub with a display. The rumoured device could feature a 7-inch screen, tvOS-based software, Siri AI and smart home controls, with its launch reportedly expected later this year.
title: Apple Reportedly Reworks Stores Ahead of HomePod, Apple TV Refreshes

description: Xiaomi’s upcoming wide-format foldable has surfaced in a new leak, with CEO Lei Jun pictured holding a burgundy-coloured handset. The handset is expected to debut the company’s Xring O3 chipset and could feature a 7.76-inch inner display, 200-megapixel Leica camera and 6,000mAh battery. Xiaomi may also offer a transparent version. The phone has appeared under several names, including Mix Fold 5 and Mix Ultra, while reports point to a September 2026 launch alongside the expected arrival of Apple’s first foldable iPhone.
title: Xiaomi Teases Xring O3 Chip as CEO Lei Jun Spotted With Rumoured New Foldable

description: Apple is preparing to launch the new iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max next month at higher prices, according to Bloomberg’s Mark Gurman. The two flagship smartphones are said to see a notable price hike over their predecessors, the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max. The company has reportedly been looking at how much Samsung and Google have raised the prices of their flagship handsets and how the companies have dealt with the rising costs of critical memory and storage components. The report also highlights that since Samsung and Google have increased the prices of their phone by $100 (roughly Rs. 10,000), Apple could do the same to its flagship handset.
title: Apple Prepares to Raise iPhone Prices Next Month Following Samsung, Google’s Recent Moves: Report

description: Bitcoin remained near Rs. 73.7 lakh after a sharp rally, with institutional demand supporting prices as investors assess stretched technical conditions and rising Japanese bond yields. Ethereum and XRP also participated in the broader recovery, while upcoming US PCE inflation data and the Jackson Hole meeting could influence the market’s next move.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $77,000 as ETF Demand Fuels Rally Despite Japan Yield Risk

description: Grand Theft Auto 6 leaks continued over the weekend, with more alleged gameplay clips surfacing on the internet. New videos show Jason, one of GTA 6's two protagonists, involved in different activities. Rockstar Games and Take-Two have filed subpoena requests in a US court, seeking information on online accounts sharing and posting leaked videos.
title: More GTA 6 Leaks Surface as Take-Two Subpoenas Microsoft, Discord to Track Down Leaker

description: Lava Virat V1 Pro 5G has been launched in India, joining the Virat V1 5G and Virat V1 4G. The handset is set to go on sale in the country on August 31 at 12 pm IST via Flipkart. The Lava Virat V1 Pro 5G is offered in Sikkim Midnight and Spiti Frost colour options. It ships with Android 16. The phone sports a 6.75-inch HD+ (720 x 1,600 pixels) LCD touchscreen, which offers up to a 120Hz refresh rate and 260 ppi pixel density. The smartphone is equipped with an octa-core Unisoc T8200 chipset, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.6GHz, along with 6GB of RAM and 128GB of internal storage.
title: Lava Virat V1 Pro 5G Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Specifications

description: The Redmi Note 17 Pro and Note 17 Pro Max could arrive in India on September 15, according to a leak. The two smartphones are also expected to cost more than the previous Note 15 Pro models. Xiaomi has already confirmed the global debut of the Note 17 series for August 27. The Pro Max is confirmed to feature a 10,000mAh battery and 100W charging, while the lineup will include large AMOLED displays, multiple water and dust resistance ratings and photochromic designs.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro, Note 17 Pro Max India Launch Date Leaked Ahead of Global Debut

description: The iMac is among the very few devices that does not have an yearly release cycle and rarely receives any updates. Apple last updated its all-in-one computer with the M4 chip and a splash of new colour options in 2024. According to a seasoned journalist, the Cupertino-based tech giant is preparing its first new iMac in two years. The next-generation computer could be reportedly set to receive the company's upcoming M6 chipset, although a major redesign is not on the cards.
title: Apple Reportedly Planning iMac Refresh With M6 Chip, New Colour Options Before End of 2026

description: Google is confirmed to launch the Fitbit Air in India soon. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the screenless fitness tracker is allegedly already already appearing in stores. Photos shared online show the Fitbit Air in multiple colour options. One retailer also appears to be already selling the FitAir Air for a slightly higher rate than its global pricing. Google, meanwhile, has already confirmed an India launch for October, but has not revealed the exact date or official price.
title: Google Fitbit Air Allegedly Available in Retail Stores Ahead of India Launch

description: Apple’s first foldable iPhone is finally expected to be unveiled later this year alongside the iPhone 18 Pro models. The device, dubbed the iPhone Ultra, is likely to enter into a category which already has rivals from Samsung, Oppo, Google, and other brands. While there are still a few weeks to go before its debut, a select group of people have reportedly had a chance to try out Apple’s first ever foldable. They praise its larger display yet a pocket-friendly design, hinge, and iPad-like app layouts.
title: iPhone Ultra Reportedly Impresses Early Users With Its Pocket-Friendly Design and Foldable Display
